_about: Extracted from "Stylish Nari Saree Catalog.xlsx" (sheet Sarees) and images/images. highRes = the full-size extra_photo that is the same photograph as imageFile (24x24 colour-fingerprint match: score = mean difference, nextBest = the runner-up; a real match is under 10, unrelated photos score 17+). unmatched = extra photos (sheet "Photos without details") that match no catalogue photo.
sheetNotes: D1: Read from the last number in the WhatsApp message. Check against the original message if anything looks off.
E1: Based on the seller's message "Here onwards semi premium banarasi silk sarees I'm sharing": everything described before it is Premium, everything after it is Semi-premium.
F1: Full-size photo with this name is in the images folder next to this file.
C1: These photos were sent in the catalog batches but no description was replied to them. They may be extra angles of a saree on the Sarees sheet. Fill in the yellow cells if needed.
